newsitem.title: NETHERLANDS: Dutch Dec manufacturing output down 0.6 pct yr/yr.
newsitem.headline: Dutch Dec manufacturing output down 0.6 pct yr/yr.

text.p: Dutch seasonally adjusted manufacturing production fell 0.6 percent in December compared with November, the Central Bureau of Statistics (CBS) said.
In December 1996 manufacturing production was 0.6 percent lower than in the same month of 1995, the CBS added.
DUTCH MANUFACTURING PRODUCTION Dec 96 Nov 96 Dec 95
NOTE - CBS calculates month-on-month changes on basis of seasonally adjusted index and year-on-year changes on basis of non-seasonally adjusted index.
The CBS said manufacturing production for the whole of 1996 was 2.0 percent higher than in 1995. In 1995 Dutch manufacturing production was 2.3 percent higher than in 1994.
